subject: Twice to a Billlion!
author: Dodger455
body:
Everyone knows that dcb9mx is the Showtime king right?So I wanted to try to get a billion points on I-88, and on the 2nd try I had 638,808,150 not bad, then this weekend I got insane and nailed a 1.2 billion, but to my horror the game still registered my other score, so I tried again.I again got a billion, and still my old score of 638,808,150 remains.It takes quite an effort not to mention time to get 110 buses, 4100 cars, and 15,000,000 points!

This happened to me once on a massive stunt run, and I never figured it out, I had to do it all over, can anyone end my pain, and tell me what is going on?
